notes:
What's new in 0.1.83:
• The Windows installer is now digitally signed (publisher: Nicholas Will). Windows may still show a short warning at first.
• The converter no longer deletes your original while rejecting a conversion.
• Photo backup, Live TV recordings and Story Studio never overwrite your files without asking.
• Restoring or importing a data export cannot overwrite your settings by accident.
• Shared trip videos are refused if they would reveal a GPS location.
• Updates wait if Beebo cannot tell whether someone is watching; bad partial downloads are discarded.
• Odd saved values no longer crash sign-in, licence checks or settings.
• Parental PIN lock-outs and sign-in are more robust.
• Starting a second copy no longer stops a running conversion.
• Cloud passwords over 1000 characters can no longer sign in.
• Built from commit 1d9af251c, Oct 8, 2026, 10:58 PM Eastern.
